geometry: Opaque rooted laid-over clipped hairs replace uniform translucent coverage. Fibers grow along the actual head surface and shorten/thin toward the boundary. Buried crown coverage ends under dense grown hair. Longer lock terminals are shortened and flattened into the upper side groom; rear overhang reduced.
selection: Independent selectors retained. Default/Black/Blonde use canonical GLBs and recolor material factors; Ombré resolves canonical hair paths through catalogue254.ombre. New Ombré preserves vertex/index/normal/UV buffers; only color attributes and material color factors change.
preservation: All body, face, wardrobe, headgear shapes, fixed studio, palettes, other six masculine and eight feminine hairstyles remain253. Side part has opaque sides and Buzz is a uniform close cut; neither has the affected faded-side construction. Sprout clips are reseated on final hair/headgear support.
exports: 16 canonical hair GLBs,16 Ombré counterparts and16 seated sprouts. Ordinary uncompressed/unquantized GLBs in common coordinates. Modeled fade uses OPAQUE materials; no alpha fog, cutout shader or runtime physics.
source: Two packed masculine reference scenes, Taper and Curly top, imported from final ordinary GLBs. All dependencies embedded. Feminine reference remains unchanged at ../253/assemblies/Feminine-assembly253.blend. Authoring scripts reference retained earlier working sources; the packed scenes are portable source checkpoints.
rendering: Blender studio lights/environment, exposure/view transform and renderer effects are recorded with the scenes and do not transfer as the same GLB lighting. PBR geometry/maps/materials transfer; compare faithful native output separately.
depth: 12 matched120/512 color and32-bit float Z pairs from the same geometry/camera/render. Existing feminine253 references stay valid because geometry/camera/materials are unchanged. These are assembled references, not component occlusion or lens-transmission maps.
qualification: Fidelity art exports; triangle counts are recorded, not a mobile performance qualification.
